headline: Do Man United need to make a decision on Carrick's future?
description: Do Man United need to make a decision on Carrick's future?

headline: Sources: United consider Howe, Nagelsmann to replace under-fire Carrick
description: Manchester United are weighing up replacements with Michael Carrick's future as head coach in serious doubt, sources told ESPN.

headline: Carrick woes deepen as Bournemouth smash United
description: The pressure on Michael Carrick continues to grow as Manchester United fall to a dispiriting 3-0 loss to Bournemouth at Old Trafford.

headline: Sunderland stay bottom of PL table after goalless draw with Leeds
description: Sunderland and Leeds were forced to share the spoils in a goalless stalemate at the Stadium of Light.

headline: Harry Maguire: Man United players are 'fully behind' Michael Carrick
description: Harry Maguire has said that he and his teammates are "fully behind" Michael Carrick after Manchester United slumped to a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth on Sunday.

headline: Brighton's Fabian Hürzeler digs at Liverpool - 'one team' tried to create
description: Brighton & Hove Albion boss Fabian Hurzeler appeared to take a swipe at Liverpool's approach in their 2-0 win over his side at Anfield, claiming there was "one team" who tried to create.
